name: skillry
description: Installable, permission-bounded, multi-platform agent skills & subagents by FluxonLab.

plugins.name: skillry-ai-and-agent-systems
plugins.description: Agent workflow design (LangChain, MCP servers, Copilot SDK), prompt systems and execution prompts, RAG/vector search, and LLM evaluation.

plugins.name: skillry-backend-and-api
plugins.description: API/interface design and OpenAPI, backend review with integration boundaries, auth/session and authorization, error handling and observability, and Python/FastAPI project review.

plugins.name: skillry-cloud-and-infrastructure
plugins.description: Cloud and infrastructure: service architecture, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), containers (Docker, multi-stage builds), and Kubernetes manifests — distinct from CI/CD pipeline review.

plugins.name: skillry-core-operations
plugins.description: Repo diagnostics and codebase mapping, architecture review and ADRs, specs and implementation planning, refactor safety, diff and regression review, release readiness (deploy preflight, rollback, handoff), and project bootstrap.

plugins.name: skillry-data-ml-ai-engineering
plugins.description: Data and ML engineering: data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data quality & validation, feature engineering, notebook hygiene, model training/serving, experiment tracking, and dataset versioning.

plugins.name: skillry-database-and-data
plugins.description: Prisma, Postgres/Supabase, migrations, seeds/fixtures, query performance, and RLS/edge functions.

plugins.name: skillry-devops-and-release
plugins.description: CI/CD pipeline review and GitHub Actions hardening.

plugins.name: skillry-documentation-and-tech-writing
plugins.description: Technical documentation agents (docs reviewer, technical writer). Their skill, technical-writing-review, ships in the product-docs-and-research plugin.

plugins.name: skillry-frontend-web-design
plugins.description: Web design review (UI consistency, polish, responsive layout, dashboards, design systems), accessibility, landing-page conversion, i18n parity, and Next.js RSC.

plugins.name: skillry-gaming-interactive-media
plugins.description: Game architecture, gameplay systems, game UI/UX, performance, prototypes, engine triage, and browser-game stacks (Phaser, Three.js, PixiJS).

plugins.name: skillry-mobile-desktop
plugins.description: Mobile app review with iOS HIG and Android Material references.

plugins.name: skillry-optional-specialist
plugins.description: Domain specialists: e-commerce and WordPress/WooCommerce, NFC/linktree and print design, local LLM runtime, Chrome extensions, maps/geo, analytics, SEO/GEO, cost control, and monorepo.

plugins.name: skillry-performance-and-cost
plugins.description: Performance engineering: frontend performance budgets and Core Web Vitals, backend latency, memory and resource profiling, caching, and Python performance.

plugins.name: skillry-product-docs-and-research
plugins.description: Product requirements and prioritization, market and customer research, business model and pricing, and technical writing (READMEs, API docs, tutorials, runbooks, changelogs).

plugins.name: skillry-runtime-and-local-app
plugins.description: Local-first apps, runtime diagnostics, startup/health gates, launchers, and log bundles.

plugins.name: skillry-security
plugins.description: Secrets and config hardening (env, Electron, Redis), AI and agent security (governance, MCP gatekeeping), and dependency and agent supply chain.

plugins.name: skillry-skill-library-and-installation
plugins.description: Skill librarian, deduplication, skill-to-agent routing, installation audit, and path hygiene.

plugins.name: skillry-testing-and-qa
plugins.description: Smoke test and repair (build/typecheck), Playwright E2E and visual regression, and UAT acceptance with functional test design.
